title: ITI Ltd issues corrigendum to audited financial results for FY26 ITI Limited has issued a corrigendum to its audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, substituting figures for profit before tax and other comprehensive income while confirming no impact on the net profit for the financial year. The revised consolidated figures show a profit before tax of ₹2,294 crore and a total comprehensive income of ₹42,761 crore, while standalone profit after tax was revised to ₹43,591 crore
